images.title: Three planes, three views
images.purpose: Shows a cylinder inside three perpendicular planes with its front view, top view and side view drawn on them.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. An open corner of three perpendicular pale grey planes in oblique view: one behind, one below, one at the left side; the cylinder floats in the middle, and each plane carries one flat view.
images.exact_structure: Back (vertical) plane, floor (horizontal) plane and left side plane drawn as pale grey parallelograms meeting at a corner. In the middle an upright cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 8 cm filled teal #0072B2. On the back plane: a 6 by 8 rectangle outlined amber #E69F00, labelled 'front view', with '6 cm' under it and '8 cm' beside it. On the floor plane: a circle of radius 3 outlined green #009E73, drawn as a foreshortened ellipse, labelled 'top view', with a radius line labelled 'radius 3 cm'. On the side plane: a 6 by 8 rectangle outlined amber, labelled 'side view'. No projector lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The front view is on the plane behind, the top view on the floor, the side view on the side plane.
images.description: Shows a cylinder inside three perpendicular planes with its front view, top view and side view drawn on them.
images.context: Concept T11.C1; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Front and side: 6 cm by 8 cm rectangles; top: circle of radius 3 cm.

image_decisions.why: The three planes are a spatial arrangement that words alone do not convey.
